note: He fits the physical half of the ICP and almost none of the commercial half. Not deconditioned at all — 6'0", 202 lb, down from 220 lb, trains about an hour a day and hikes ten miles with camera gear — and he genuinely is chasing good-to-great within the limits of being 60: 'I just got as high as I can possibly do without being a professional.' But he is a salaried designer and printer at Funko, not a business owner or physician; his personal account is overdrawn, he is barred from the joint account, he is struggling with an existing car payment and he faces unquantified divorce costs, so 'makes good money' fails on every observable test. Most importantly, health is not the neglected corner of an otherwise good life — it is the one area he has been managing hardest, having reversed a diabetes diagnosis without medication under a doctor and a nutritionist, while the rest of his life is in acute crisis. That is the inverse of the stated profile, and it is also the reason the ICP's missing clinical criterion bites hardest here.
